intro.text: Pars the Deadman, a murderer Wax caught in Weathering.

items.text: A butcher from Elendel, Pars began by killing beggars in the city, then fled to Weathering in the Roughs once he was found out. Wax learned he was there and hunted him with Miles Dagouter's help, through many anxious, sleepless nights.
Pars seemed to toy with Wax, leaving victims such as Old Burlow's daughter where Wax was sure to find them. His capture was hailed as one of Wax's finest.

Miles counted the case among those that turned him against Elendel: he felt Elendel ought to have sent men to help hunt Pars down, and took its failure to do so as proof that its people cared nothing for the Roughs.
